title: Byte Unpacking
text: Deconstruct data frames, 1 input, 1 output, {Output port (unpacked) data types (cell array)} sets Data types for the unpacked output signals; {Output port (unpacked) dimensions (cell array)} sets the dimensions of each output port and {Byte Alignment} sets the alignment of the output signal data types before. Values come from the instance.
